title: Navy concert band and lessons with Gilbert Mitchell
summary: Davenport recalls the Navy symphonic band and studying privately with Gilbert Mitchell in 1945 before Xavier.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: The End The End So a military band, a concert military band, played just about all the stars for them.
Did you ever play on a symphony?

Well a symphonic band when I was in the Navy. Like a concert band? Yeah. But we didn't have the strings. We didn't have the strings. Well I studied with a guy who played with the New Orleans Symphony Orchestra, Gilbert Mitchell. I studied with him in 55. And I studied with him a good while. That was when you were at Xavier. Oh no, this was before I went to Xavier. I was taking private lessons before I went to Xavier. I took lessons from Gilbert Mitchell as soon as I got out of the Navy. And the reason why I stopped, he got tired of the New Orleans and went to Philadelphia. That's where he was from.
1945. How did he go to Xavier until 1950? What about timing? Timing? Yeah.
